title: Deep Digger Web
hook: Dig through a vertical mine with a limited energy budget, cash out gems, trigger TNT chains, dodge traps, and buy persistent pickaxe, satchel, and lamp upgrades.
mechanic: Grid digging with extracted Dig out-style tile grammar: ground, stone, obsidian walls, gems, energy gems, TNT boxes, chests, thorns, snakes, bats, spiders, and totems. Uses extracted reward values but generated original layouts.
progression: Coins, best depth, persistent upgrades, run achievements, and escalating mine difficulty.
rights_note: Clean-room web implementation. No APK art, code, brands, or exact level maps are shipped.
